## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, bold, big headings
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Oswald,
  display=Oswald, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary | Tokens: primary=#FAFAFA, secondary=#FAFAFA,
  success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626, surface=#000000,
  text=#ffffff
- Spacing scale: 8pt baseline grid

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

High-end dark aesthetic with bold headings, a monochromatic palette, and a
premium visual tone for brand experiences.
